slides.title: Adapt [the proof], not the paint.
slides.lede: Colours rarely lose a mandate in a new market. Unrecognised evidence does.

slides.title: Most firms treat it as [a design job]
slides.text: Deciding what stays consistent across markets is a question of authority. A firm that cannot say what is fixed has no basis for refusing a local request.

slides.title: Buyers protect [their own standing]
slides.text: of professional services buyers had chosen a familiar supplier over a better-value alternative to protect their internal career standing.
slides.source: VML, The Future Buyer: Professional Services, 2026

items.title: Fixed
items.text: Name, positioning, core identity. Managing partner or board.

items.title: Flexed
items.text: Case studies, credentials, tone. The brand owner.

items.title: Free
items.text: Local channels, referrals, events. Local office lead.

cards.label: Adapt
cards.text: Local case studies and credentials buyers recognise.

cards.label: Dilute
cards.text: A different positioning claim in every market.

slides.quote: Gaps in that list are your real exposure.
slides.text: List every brand element on one page. Mark each Fixed, Flexed or Free, and write one approver beside each.
